capabilities: Find matches within the selected text
Replace the current match or all matches at once
Jump between matches with arrow buttons and highlighted results
Undo a Replace all with a single undo
Run from the command palette or a hotkey
extras: Installable via BRAT as a beta plugin; the README's release section (version bumping, tagging, GitHub workflow) is aimed at developers rather than users.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search and replace works across the whole note, so there is no simple way to limit replacements to a selected region.
summary: Scoped find-and-replace tool that searches and replaces text only within the current editor selection, with multiple selections supported.
